_status: Proposed synthetic pilot checklists; agency leads must review applicability before any real use.

paid_campaign.business_objective: What business outcome does this campaign support?
paid_campaign.conversion_and_kpi: What conversion and KPI will define success, and over what period?
paid_campaign.audience_and_offer: Who is the audience, and what offer or message is approved?
paid_campaign.landing_page: Which landing page is required and who owns its readiness?
paid_campaign.tracking_owner: Who owns measurement and verifies tracking before launch?
paid_campaign.budget_and_dates: What budget and dates have been agreed or remain unresolved?
paid_campaign.assets_and_approvals: Which assets, rights and approvals are required?

organic_social.business_objective: What outcome and audience should the content serve?
organic_social.channels_and_cadence: Which channels, quantities and publishing cadence are required?
organic_social.voice_and_mandatories: Which brand voice and mandatory restrictions apply?
organic_social.assets_and_rights: Which assets and usage permissions are available?
organic_social.approvals_and_dates: Who approves the content and by which dates?
organic_social.measurement: Which measures and reporting period will assess the work?

creative_production.objective_and_audience: What objective, audience and proposition govern production?
creative_production.deliverables_and_variants: Which deliverables, quantities, variants and languages are required?
creative_production.mandatories_and_rights: Which restrictions, brand requirements and usage rights apply?
creative_production.dependencies: Which supplied assets or other teams does production depend on?
creative_production.approvals_and_dates: Who approves each milestone, and by which dates?
